scientific_integrity: The finite-support reduction and dimension threshold are proved for all admissible weights, not extrapolated from computation; exact-rational tests are supplementary. Bibliographic priority remains qualified by inaccessible primary text.
scientific_limitations: Finite real weighted-rearrangement Lorentz spaces only; the precise hyperplane has coordinate sum zero; all weights are positive and nonincreasing. The paper gives no assertions for arbitrary hyperplanes, complex spaces, or infinite sequences. Full texts of Jameson (1999) and Kaminska-Lee-Lewicki (2009) were not available for comprehensive priority checking. No independent validation has occurred.
title: Exact centering constants and a three-dimensional exception in real Lorentz sequence spaces
